verdict.rationale: Reclaim offers a no-cost Lite plan for any single user, described as covering 'essential smart time blocking features' (reclaim-docs-16, reclaim-docs-28), and it separately documents Scheduling Links for sharing bookable availability (reclaim-docs-49, reclaim-docs-2). However, nothing in the pack confirms that Scheduling Links are included in Lite, and the Lite description stresses time blocking rather than booking. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that booking links are available on the free Lite plan, any free-tier limits on links or meeting types, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a free user can share a working booking link.
